correctness.rationale: In the exact RESULT.md proof the probability-normalized cosine q moment equals Gamma((q+1)/2)/(sqrt(pi) Gamma((q+2)/2)); the qth root is the strict increasing Lq norm of a nonconstant random variable and q=p/(p-1) decreases, so r_p strictly increases. Gamma-ratio asymptotic Cq=1-[log q+log(pi/2)]/(2q)+O((log q)^2/q^2) yields coefficient 1/9 after expanding 1/(1+2Cq). At q=1, differentiating log Cq gives log(pi)-1 and therefore coefficient -4*pi*(log pi-1)/(pi+4)^2. Endpoint q=1,2,infty cosine moments produce stated values; no source sharpness re-proof claimed. Independent direct gamma evaluations at p=1.0001 and p=1000 agreed with asymptotic scale and constants but are not proofs.
residual_risks: Asymptotic analysis of a previously published radius expression, not independent proof of its sharpness.
